_note: Player names read by eye from the leaderboard screenshots, for rows where no other source could supply one. Highest precedence in export_captures: this file, then the rank popup's name, then the leaderboard OCR.
_why: Two automatic readers cover almost everything. The rank popup gives a model-read name for 94% of players, and Tesseract on the leaderboard row handles plain Latin text. What is left over is the intersection of the two failures: a player whose popup never resolved AND whose name Tesseract cannot represent -- CJK, Hangul, Cyrillic, and Latin styled with Greek or small-cap glyphs. That was 58 rows out of 6294, so they were transcribed by eye rather than paid for.
_truncated: A name ending in '...' is truncated BY THE GAME. The leaderboard row clips long names and there is no wider render of them to read, so the ellipsis is what the player's name looks like in this UI, not a reading failure.
